claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Nornicotine is a weak nicotinic acetylcholine receptor agonist with no potent cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM; any modest antiproliferative effect would likely reflect weak mitochondrial complex I inhibition or nonspecific alkaloid stress rather than a class-specific killing pattern.
